chapters.decision: Preserve the introductory Jeremiah narrative within 1:1, every poetic line break, the personified city, weeping repetition, rams, captivity, watch/pains/hands, the winepress and the 15–16 boundary. Sat in 1 and groaned/turned in 8 make the past setting explicit. Made me desolate replaces the awkward made me destroyed in 13, retaining the devastation. Ordinary plural address in 18 uses you; direct divine address in 10 and 21–22 retains Thou/Thee/Thine. The opening Hear in 21 is plural before the direct divine address. Retain the difficult Not to you opening in 12 and the singular eye in 16.

chapters.decision: Preserve drowning, the vine dwelling, king/priest/ruler, the bringing down of leading virgins, heart and glory, the cup of crushing, exult, the butcher/gleaning clause, captivity plus sword/famine and the first-person multiplication of enemies. Address to Jerusalem and Zion in 13–19 uses you/your; the walls command in 18 is plural before the singular daughter address. Direct questions and prayer to God in 20–21 retain Thou/Thine. Quotation marks clarify the children’s question and the enemies’ speech without changing line breaks.

chapters.decision: Preserve all 62 existing units and the accessed Greek gaps at 22–24 and 29, without inserting familiar mercies or dust verses. Keep the bronze, kidneys, pebble, psalm, gall, future endurance, good at the end of 25, and passive our way was searched. Indeed, I will cry and call out in 8 expresses the emphatic future without the awkward even though I will. Made me desolate in 11 matches the revised 1:13 image. Will not ... come in 38 makes the future explicit; acted godlessly in 42 corrects the English adverb. Hunted and hunted in 52 restores the Greek verbal emphasis. Direct prayer in 42–45 and 55–66 retains Thou/Thee/Thy/Thine; third-person verbs in 50 are modern. Preserve singular eye, eyes/prayer, their eyes and Thy toil.

chapters.decision: Keep the future gold/silver opening, holy stones, dragons, plural daughters and singular sparrow, Nazirites, sapphire stones, watchmen, touching garments, the Lord’s face as portion and we hunted our little ones. In 7 restore the Greek plural subject: they glowed red ... in their cut portion, following the provisional accusative-of-respect construal recorded in the historical editorial guide. Retain the Lord’s anointed rather than importing a later identification, and preserve Idumea in 21 and Edom in 22 because the accessed Greek names differ. Address to the daughters uses you/your; quotation marks clarify 15 and 20.

chapters.decision: Keep the abbreviated 4 exactly as accessed: From our days, our wood came in exchange. The current publisher display lacks the water-for-silver clause asserted by an older study note; no clause is inserted from that assertion. Preserve Egypt as giver, Assyria/their satisfaction, future bread in 9, livid skin and famine storms, weeping in 13, foxes, the future divine dwelling/forgetting questions, turn back/be turned back and the final For. Direct prayer retains Thou/Thee/Thy; ordinary third-person has and endures are modernized.
